design.selection: smallest SHA256(movement-ID)64 eligible flights per airport/day; quarter/middle/three-quarter retained ground points
design.eligibility: known aircraft/stand; at least3 retained ground points with speed0..60kt,0..7200s before takeoff, sameUTCday and >=200m from stand
design.donors: retained ground positions with observed speed0..60kt, same airport/UTCday; exact raw absolute timestamp, no interpolation
design.exclusion: all same known aircraft and same movement-ID or exact known takeoff/actualclock/stand/runway aliases
design.prediction: median of per-aircraft observed speed medians; equally weighted aircraft; matched count across actual-past,6hour-shift null,spatial-only
design.positive: observed peer motion, not absent-peer imputation; unsupported rows remain unpredicted
design.gate: each date >=10% matched-support coverage; each date MAE at least5% lower than BOTH controls and pooled at least10% lower
design.limits: 90seconds,oneCPUthread,noGPU; original two shared-training pilot dates, no date/threshold search
design.interpretation: Source-speed observability/predictability only; no taxi-error headroom or candidate claim
